answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 14603 Country: India Title: It is necessary to women to wait for adhan to perform prayer or she can pray without adhan if prayer time has started. Question: It is necessary to women to wait for adhan to perform prayer or she can pray without adhan if prayer time has started. Answer ID: 14603 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1138/1138=M/1430) If the time of salah is already due, the women can perform salah without azan as well. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
